mapper.sql: pi.id, pi.receipt_no, pi.inbound_source, pi.purchase_id, pi.refund_id, pi.supplier_id, pi.warehouse_id, pi.total_quantity, pi.total_amount, pi.status, pi.receive_time, pi.user_id, pi.remark, pi.create_by, pi.update_by, pi.create_time, pi.update_time

FROM shop_erp_purchase_in pi LEFT JOIN shop_erp_purchase p ON p.id = pi.purchase_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_refund rf ON rf.id = pi.refund_id AND rf.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_erp_supplier sp ON sp.id = pi.supplier_id AND sp.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_erp_warehouse w ON w.id = pi.warehouse_id AND w.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON eu.id = pi.user_id
(SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ri.received_quantity), 0) FROM shop_erp_purchase_in_item ri WHERE ri.receipt_id = pi.id AND ri.is_deleted = 0) AS totalReceived
mapper.select:
SELECT , , p.purchase_no AS purchaseNo, rf.refund_no AS refundNo, sp.supplier_name AS supplierName, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, w.status AS warehouseStatus, eu.nickname AS userName
WHERE pi.id = #{id} AND pi.is_deleted = 0

SELECT , , p.purchase_no AS purchaseNo, rf.refund_no AS refundNo, sp.supplier_name AS supplierName, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, w.status AS warehouseStatus, eu.nickname AS userName
WHERE pi.purchase_id = #{purchaseId} AND pi.is_deleted = 0
AND pi.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY pi.id DESC
